card.name: Inside blood-count condition words
card.fires_on: Mid-word pieces of blood-cell deficiency terms, such as the 'open' in thrombocytopenia and lymphopenia or the 'rop' in neutropenia. Also fires on a few closing marks, such as ')' after RF or 'days' after 'every 21'.
